info.title: How to play
info.connections.heading: Connections
info.connections.body:
You get 16 words shuffled at random. Your job is to sort them into 4 groups of 4.

There is only one correct grouping. A word may look like it fits two categories, but that's the trap.

Pick 4 words you think belong together. If wrong, try again. Depending on the puzzle, you'll have 4 mistakes or unlimited tries. If you pick 3 out of 4 correctly, the game will say "One away!".

Groups are color-coded from easiest to hardest.
